constraints: Existing links with no alias and no expiry keep redirecting.
Soft-delete with DELETE /api/v1/urls/{code} stays independent of expiry.
Include an impact analysis of modules, APIs, and data flow.

acceptance: reserved aliases are rejected and a colliding alias returns 409.
functional_requirements.statement: Accept an optional alias on POST /api/v1/urls.

acceptance: ttl_seconds or expires_at is stored, and GET /{code} returns 410 after the link is expired.
functional_requirements.statement: Accept an optional expiration on POST /api/v1/urls.

acceptance: clicks recorded before expiry remain in the totals.
functional_requirements.statement: Keep analytics available with GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/stats after expiry.

out_of_scope: Backfilling an expiration onto links that were created without one.
problem_statement: The shortener already creates links, redirects them, and records clicks. Add optional custom aliases and optional expiration without changing links that use neither.
title: Custom aliases and expiration
